reference.method: unchanged pinned Pool.swap / CLPool.swap in Solidity storage-seeding harnesses
reference.evm: Ganache 7.9.2 Shanghai; original library closure compiled with solc 0.8.26 to both Shanghai and Cancun; Shanghai artifacts executed
reference.expectation_policy: expected.reverted also means full positive-output quote rejected for partial input, zero output, combined fee >= 1e6, or positive input > 2^127 (2^127 inclusive is source-valid); raw EVM result always retained under reference
reference.manager_code_sha256_policy: synthetic fixture identity: SHA256 of pinned manager SOURCE file, not deployed manager runtime bytecode; never a production code attestation
reference.max_steps_policy: 512 is larger than every possible bitmap/tick iteration for these covered word windows; the original library has no configurable max_steps
reference.price_limit_policy: each call is bounded to the supplied continuous bitmap word window; omitted external words are never treated as known empty liquidity
limits: No manager unlock, transient storage, settlement, hooks, token behavior, external RPC, or production deployed-code attestation is executed.
Storage is seeded directly after native initialize; tick/position construction validation is not exercised.
Cancun-target artifacts compile but are not executed; only original-library Shanghai artifacts execute.
